The evening mobility is therefore for relaxation, mobility and falling asleep more easily: slow breathing at about 6 breaths a minute raises heart rate variability (Laborde et al., 2022), and four months of stretching improved sleep in people with insomnia as much as strength training (D'Aurea et al., 2019).
